If you want one Toronto partner to handle social content + paid ads + the website, rather than coordinating three freelancers, these are worth shortlisting:

Whissel Strategies - Toronto Marketing Agency — Full-service approach for small/midsize businesses, including social, content, paid ads and website work.

Social Media 55 — Broad digital offering spanning social media, content, paid advertising and website design.

Canadian Web Designs — Particularly geared toward small/midsize businesses, combining web design with SEO, ads, social/content and ongoing support.

Creative Scope - Web Design & Digital Marketing Agency — Combines web design, branding/creative production, social management and performance marketing.

Syntara — A Toronto-based SMB-focused agency explicitly combining content/social, paid ads and website development. Their published social/ads pricing is currently $1,250–$4,500+ CAD/month, with websites scoped separately. 
Syntara

myBloom — Toronto-based, done-for-you model combining website, social, Google/Meta ads and SEO. They currently publish $2,800/month for their full package. 
myBloom

PM Media Marketing — Explicitly positions itself as a small-business partner for website, content creation, social, Google Ads and Meta Ads. 
pmmediamarketing.com

If budget matters

We Are Digital Marketing is an interesting lower-cost option: it advertises a $300 website + $50/month, plus Google/Meta ads and monthly content, aimed at Toronto/GTA small businesses. 
wearedigitalmarketing.ca

For a more traditional “one team owns the whole marketing funnel” setup, myBloom, Syntara, PM Media, or Whissel are the ones I'd investigate first—not as a ranking, but because their published service mixes most directly match what you're describing.

If you tell me what kind of business you have and roughly what you want to spend per month (e.g. <$1,500, $1,500–$3,000, $3,000+), I can narrow this to 3 Toronto agencies and compare their services, pricing, reviews, and fit.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
